title: Analyzing Impact of Energy Policies in the Market
summary: Evaluated global policy effectiveness applying time-series and panel data econometric techniques in R and Excel to measure price elasticity and market distortions.
arch: Multi-Country Energy Dataset -> ADF Unit Root Tests -> Panel Regression (Fixed/Random Effects) -> Policy Elasticity Estimation
details: Conducted empirical evaluation of global energy policies using advanced panel data methods, assessing regulatory impact on market equilibrium and deadweight loss.

title: Analyzing Sustainability in Global Value Chains
summary: Examined global value chain metrics to map sustainability risks, carbon footprints, and production efficiencies across cross-border manufacturing networks.
arch: Cross-Border Trade Data -> Value Added Decomposition -> ESG Risk Scoring -> Supply Chain Efficiency Mapping
details: Mapped multi-tier production networks and quantified sustainability vulnerabilities to inform strategic risk mitigation in international trade.

title: The Perceived Effectiveness of E-Governance
summary: Evaluated the impact of digital governance initiatives on citizen satisfaction, administrative transparency, and public service delivery.
arch: Citizen Survey Data -> Data Cleaning & Coding -> Statistical Hypothesis Testing -> Impact Evaluation Report
details: Analyzed administrative datasets and citizen feedback surveys to measure the efficiency gains of digital public service platforms.

title: Role of Skill-Based Education and Employment
summary: Studied the impact of vocational education programs on improving student employability, wage premiums, and labor market integration.
arch: Employment Census Data -> Matching Estimators -> Wage Premium Regression -> Labor Market Insights
details: Investigated the causal effect of vocational training interventions on youth employment outcomes and skill mismatch reduction.
